# bn-grid

Layouelment to latout child componets in a static grid defined by columns and rows.

## Mixins
@withStyle

**Example**
```html
 <bn-body>
  <bn-grid rows="1" columns="1" top="0" left="0" height="100%">
    ...
  </bn-grid>
</bn-body>
```
